capabilities: Render mindmaps from indented code-block text
Draw reverse bracket logic trees for syllogisms and conclusions
Style diagrams per block with @ directives and a hover toolbar
Export diagrams to the vault as SVG, PNG, or JPG
Switch flow direction between RTL, LTR, top-to-bottom, and bottom-to-top
disambiguation: Not a freeform drawing canvas; diagrams are written as indented text in code blocks and rendered as SVG.
extras: Manifest carries the standard 'has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice. The README is fully duplicated in Persian, and installation is manual or via BRAT only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw hierarchical mindmaps or bracket-style logic trees inside notes, and existing diagram tools misalign right-to-left scripts like Persian and Arabic.
summary: Renders mindmaps and reverse bracket logic trees from indented code blocks as SVG diagrams, with native right-to-left script support.
